trigger_events: baron1 of the b1_t has officially declared war on baron2 of the b2_t.

baron1 and baron2 arrange a peaceful meeting to settle their differences. However, when both Barons bring a patrol of Clippers for defense, tensions rise, and a fight breaks out. The b1_t is at war with the b2_t.
